spans.text: Always gather relevant information using function calls (like RETRIEVE) before answering a question.
spans.note: The prompt emphasizes gathering relevant information before answering questions, using function calls like RETRIEVE and SEARCH to locate content, and basing answers on the content of the article. It instructs the system to always gather information before responding, which promotes information integrity and grounding answers in source material.

spans.text: Communicate with the user to clarify their requirements. For requests that go beyond your responsibilities, politely decline and explain the reason.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly instructs the system to communicate with users to clarify requirements, and to prompt users for necessary information. It preserves user agency by asking for clarification and informing users when only partial answers are provided, allowing them to request more.

spans.text: For requests that go beyond your responsibilities, politely decline and explain the reason.
spans.note: The prompt defines a clear scope of responsibility (reading articles and answering questions based on article content) and explicitly instructs the system to politely decline requests that go beyond its responsibilities. This provides a boundary mechanism for handling out-of-scope or potentially unsafe requests.
